projectDescription: FlareHQ is an API-first payment infrastructure platform for Web3 businesses and autonomous AI agents, enabling USDC checkouts, x402 micro-payment paywalls, streaming payments, and on-chain escrows on Arc testnet.
keyFeatures: Hosted USDC checkouts and shareable payment links
x402 HTTP 402 micro-payment paywalls for API monetization
Real-time per-second USDC payment streaming via ArcFlareStream contract
Programmatic on-chain escrow with milestone release and dispute resolution
AI agent deployment with ERC-8004 on-chain identity registry
Circle CCTP cross-chain USDC bridge into Arc testnet
Webhook event system for async payment notifications
x402 Marketplace for listing and discovering monetized APIs
publicApiSurface: POST /api/payments/initialize — create payment session and checkout URL
GET /api/payments?id={id} — retrieve payment by ID
GET /api/payments/verify/{reference} — verify payment status by reference
GET /api/payments/history — list payment history
POST /api/escrow/create — lock USDC in on-chain ArcFlareEscrow contract
POST /api/escrow/release — release escrowed funds to beneficiary
POST /api/escrow/dispute — raise an escrow dispute
GET /api/escrow/status?reference={ref} — query escrow state
POST /api/payments/stream/create — start a per-second USDC stream
POST /api/payments/stream/stop — stop an active payment stream
POST /api/payments/stream/withdraw — withdraw vested stream balance
GET /api/payments/stream — list and filter payment streams
POST /api/x402/pay — execute x402 micro-payment and proxy API call
GET /api/x402/seller/balance — fetch seller USDC earnings balance
POST /api/x402/seller/balance/withdraw — withdraw x402 earnings
POST /api/agent/deploy — provision ERC-8004 agent with Circle SCA wallets
GET /api/agent/status — query agent wallet and on-chain identity
POST /api/jobs/create — create ERC-8183 agentic commerce job
POST /api/jobs/fund — fund a job with USDC budget
POST /api/jobs/submit — submit job deliverable for evaluation
POST /api/jobs/complete — mark job complete and release payment
POST /api/merchant/signup — register merchant account
POST /api/merchant/login — authenticate and obtain session token
GET /api/merchant/me — fetch authenticated merchant profile
GET /api/merchant/dashboard — fetch revenue and payment analytics
POST /api/merchant/payment-link — create a reusable payment link
POST /api/merchant/withdraw — withdraw merchant USDC balance
POST /api/cctp/transfer — initiate cross-chain USDC bridge via Circle CCTP
GET /api/cctp/transfer/status — check CCTP bridge transfer status
FlareHQ SDK: new FlareHQ({ apiKey, environment, chain })
flarehq.checkout.createSession({ amount, currency, recipient, successUrl, cancelUrl })

flarehq.x402.executeRequest({ slug, method, params, agentId })
flarehq.x402.verifyPaymentProof(proof)
flarehq.webhooks.constructEvent(payload, signature, secret)
createX402Middleware({ priceUsdc, payTo, chainId })
